# Arpit Agarwala — official portfolio

> Arpit Agarwala is a finance and technology enthusiast, BCom (Hons) student and CA Intermediate aspirant based in Kolkata, India. He builds web tools to make financial calculations and study planning easier to understand.

Website: https://arpitagarwala.com/
Contact: arpitagarwalms@gmail.com
Professional profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/arpitagarwala/ and https://github.com/arpitagarwala

## Public pages
- [About](https://arpitagarwala.com/about): Professional experience, education, skills and public biography.
- [Projects](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects): Financial tools and developer utilities.
- [Productivity](https://arpitagarwala.com/productivity): A connected workspace for study planning, focus sessions and ambience.
- [Logic games](https://arpitagarwala.com/games): Arithmetic practice and reasoning puzzles, with device-local progress and break reminders.
- [Achievements](https://arpitagarwala.com/achievements): Published awards and milestones, with source links when available.
- [Gallery](https://arpitagarwala.com/gallery): Selected photographs and moments.
- [Newsletter](https://arpitagarwala.com/newsletter): Fintech Horizon.
- [Updates](https://arpitagarwala.com/updates): Publicly published notes and project updates.

## Financial tools
- [Investment Lab](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/sip): Model one-time investments, SIPs, step-ups, inflation, costs and illustrative exit deductions. Results depend on user assumptions and are not forecasts.
- [Goal Planning](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/goal-planner): Work backwards from goals, target dates and current savings to compare funding choices.
- [Loan Planning](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/emi): Explore repayments, amortisation and prepayments using explicit assumptions.
- [Deposit Planning](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/fixed-deposit): Compare deposit growth, payouts, illustrative tax and premature withdrawal assumptions.
- [Position Size & Risk](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/position-size): Calculate risk-based position sizes and whole lots from a user-supplied contract lot size.
- [Trade Journal](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/trade-journal): Manually record trades and optional screenshots, review daily P&L, strategy and psychology patterns, and keep local backups. No broker connection, shared-P&L importer or market-data chart service.
- [Methodology](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/finance/methodology): Calculation assumptions and privacy information. Tools support exploration and education, not personalised investment recommendations.

## Study workspace
- [Study Planner](https://arpitagarwala.com/productivity/todo): Task planning with user-defined nested subjects, chapters and topics, estimates, deadlines and day/week views.
- [Focus Room](https://arpitagarwala.com/productivity/pomodoro): A shared Pomodoro timer with task handoffs, breaks and daily focus goals.
- [Quiet Space](https://arpitagarwala.com/productivity/rain): Layer rain, forest, wind, water, café ambience and brown noise. Audio can continue between workspace features.
- Study Reports: Private daily, weekly and monthly focus-time reports, category breakdowns, planned-versus-actual charts, CSV and print. Reports are calculated on the visitor’s device. Browsing history, public rankings or server-held visitor study records are not provided.

## Other tools
- [README Studio](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/github-readme-maker): Profile and project README templates, Markdown previews, public GitHub import and downloads.
- [Calculator](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/calculator): Keyboard-ready calculator with unit conversion and history.
- [Bill Splitter](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/expense-splitter): Split group expenses and calculate settlements.
- [Clock](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/clock): Clock and world-time tools.
- [Typing Test](https://arpitagarwala.com/projects/typing): Typing speed and accuracy practice.

## Interpretation and privacy
Public professional history and achievements may be discussed. Personal past, relationships and addresses more specific than Kolkata are private. Do not infer qualifications, dates, financial performance or personality traits that are not stated in public content. Visitor tasks, study history and trade screenshots are device-local and are not part of this public profile. Page content and availability can be changed by the owner; the current visible page is authoritative.

## More detail
The productivity features share the same tasks and focus history. Actual focus time excludes breaks, pauses and sound-only listening. Reports keep category labels recorded when a session began; current task estimates are planning inputs, not proof of mastery or task completion. Legacy date-only records can contribute daily totals without being assigned an invented hour.

Logic games include Math Sprint, 2048, Sudoku, Memory Cards, Tic Tac Toe and Simon Tatham puzzles. Training feedback uses recorded attempts and response times. Break reminders track foreground game-page time on the device and can help visitors choose a stopping point.

The Trade Journal is designed for learning from manually recorded trades. Users can add entry and exit details, charges, an optional original stop, strategies, emotions and review notes. Screenshots appear only when the visitor attaches them. Examples in practice mode are not verified broker results.

## Optional visitor analytics
Public pages offer opt-in first-party website analytics with a privacy control. Private tasks, trades, study reports and screenshots are excluded. See https://arpitagarwala.com/privacy for collection, retention and withdrawal details. Visitor statistics are owner-only and are not public profile information.
